sources.title: Process Management Software
supportedClaims: The vendor page describes a level-one process map grouped into management, customer-facing, core and support categories and a level-two flowchart for each process.
The page describes named process owners and links from processes to controlled documents and standard clauses.
The page describes industry starting templates and review of supported PDF process charts before acceptance.
The vendor maps the module to ISO 9001:2015 clauses 4.4 and 5.3; this mapping is not proof that software alone satisfies requirements.

The page presents numbered configuration activities including process mapping, module configuration, standards onboarding and deployment with training. Details and applicability require demonstration.
The page states AI output is a suggestion reviewed by a person before entry into a controlled record.
These are published vendor descriptions, not verified installed behavior or proof of a particular plant’s conditions.

sources.title: ISO 9001 Auditing Practices Group
supportedClaims: The ISO 9001 Auditing Practices Group site provides educational papers on quality management system auditing, including a process-based approach and risk-based thinking.
The site says its guidance is not definitive and is not intended as specified requirements, a benchmark or mandatory audit criteria.
Its ISO 9001:2015 auditing topics include processes, evidence collection, audit planning and improvement.
